purpose: Curated original music venues, independent organizers, and unusual culture sources for discovering NEW candidate event/source links. Research only; not enabled importers.
rules: Prioritize original venue/ticket calendars and independent organizers across music genres, plus artist/vendor touring pages and selective underground or local indexes.
Never infer an event year from the date a webpage was posted, or assume a seasonal market recurrence. Vendor listings are leads, not independently verified event calendars.
Inspect actual geographic venue/location for every proposed event; out-of-region oddities and goth markets are common search false positives.
Don't automatically fetch found outbound links or private/blocked social profiles, mirror flyers, or auto-publish event data.

Research all music styles including jazz, blues, soul, hip-hop, R&B, funk, folk, global, electronic and underground rock/punk/metal, plus relevant independent zines, record fairs, markets and art. Do not crawl generic nonmusic calendars just to inflate volume.
